TOOL_INTROS.https://huggingface.co/BAAI/bge-m3: BGE-M3 is BAAI’s multilingual retrieval and embedding model. It supports dense retrieval, sparse retrieval and multi-vector retrieval, helping search systems find relevant passages across languages and document lengths. It produces retrieval representations rather than conversational answers and uses MIT licensing.
TOOL_INTROS.https://huggingface.co/intfloat/multilin: multilingual-e5-large is a multilingual text embedding model published by intfloat. It converts queries and passages into vectors for semantic similarity and information retrieval. It is useful as a component in search and retrieval-augmented generation systems, rather than as a standalone chatbot.
TOOL_INTROS.https://huggingface.co/jinaai/jina-embed: Jina embeddings v4 is Jina AI’s multimodal embedding model for text and visual document retrieval, built on Qwen2.5-VL. It maps content into representations for finding related information. Its model card identifies the governing license as the Qwen Research License.
TOOL_INTROS.https://huggingface.co/nomic-ai/nomic-em: Nomic embed text v2 MoE is Nomic AI’s multilingual mixture-of-experts text embedding model. It represents text for semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation workflows. It returns embeddings rather than chat replies, and its weights use Apache 2.0.
TOOL_INTROS.https://huggingface.co/Alibaba-NLP/gte-m: GTE multilingual base is Alibaba NLP’s multilingual text embedding model. It converts text into representations for semantic matching and retrieval, including search over documents in different languages. It is an embedding component, distinct from the Qwen chat assistant, and uses Apache 2.0.
TOOL_INTROS.https://huggingface.co/sentence-transfor: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 is a compact Sentence Transformers model that maps sentences and paragraphs to embedding vectors. It supports semantic similarity, clustering and search. It is not a conversational language model, and its weights are published under Apache 2.0.
TOOL_INTROS.https://huggingface.co/amazon/chronos-2: Chronos-2 is Amazon’s time-series forecasting model. It generates forecasts from historical observations and supports multivariate data and covariates. This is a forecasting model rather than the Amazon Nova assistant family; its weights use Apache 2.0.
TimesFM 2.5 200M is Google Research’s foundation model for time-series forecasting. It produces future estimates from historical numeric sequences. This entry links to its PyTorch checkpoint; the author notes that the checkpoint itself is not an officially supported Google product.
TOOL_INTROS.https://huggingface.co/nvidia/parakeet-t: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v2 is NVIDIA’s English automatic speech recognition model. It transcribes audio with punctuation, capitalization and timestamp support. The 600M-parameter model uses CC BY 4.0; the card also links to the newer multilingual v3 release.
TOOL_INTROS.https://huggingface.co/hexgrad/Kokoro-82: Kokoro-82M is Hexgrad’s compact text-to-speech model with 82 million parameters. It turns written text into spoken audio using supported voices and languages. The author publishes Apache-licensed weights and links an official demo from the model card.
TOOL_INTROS.https://huggingface.co/SWivid/F5-TTS: F5-TTS is a text-to-speech model that uses reference audio to condition speech generation. It supports generating spoken audio from text and is accompanied by the SWivid research implementation. The published weights use CC BY-NC 4.0; the code license is separate.
TOOL_INTROS.https://huggingface.co/Efficient-Large-M: SANA 1.5 1.6B is a text-to-image diffusion model from the SANA project. It generates images from written prompts, with this checkpoint targeting 1024-pixel output. Its metadata lists Apache 2.0, while the model card describes intended use as research.
TOOL_INTROS.https://huggingface.co/Alpha-VLLM/Lumina: Lumina-Image-2.0 is Alpha-VLLM’s 2B flow-based diffusion transformer for text-to-image generation. It creates images from written descriptions, with inference examples provided through the Diffusers library. Its weights are published under Apache 2.0.
TOOL_INTROS.https://huggingface.co/zai-org/CogVideoX: CogVideoX-5B is a text-to-video model published by Z.ai. It generates video clips from written descriptions and provides downloadable weights and inference examples. It is distinct from the Z.ai chat assistant and is governed by the CogVideoX License.
TOOL_INTROS.https://huggingface.co/microsoft/TRELLIS: TRELLIS image large is Microsoft’s image-conditioned 3D generation model. It creates 3D assets from an input image using structured 3D latent representations. This listing links to the downloadable image-conditioned checkpoint, published under the MIT license.
TOOL_INTROS.https://huggingface.co/facebook/sam2-hie: SAM 2 Hiera Large is Meta’s Segment Anything 2 model for promptable object segmentation in images and videos. It identifies and tracks selected regions rather than generating chat answers. The author provides model weights and inference examples under Apache 2.0.
TOOL_INTROS.https://huggingface.co/microsoft/Florenc: Florence-2-large is Microsoft’s vision foundation model for prompt-based tasks such as image captioning, object detection, OCR and segmentation. It interprets an image together with a task prompt and produces the corresponding output. Its weights use MIT licensing.
TOOL_INTROS.https://huggingface.co/depth-anything/De: Depth Anything V2 Small is a compact computer-vision model for monocular depth estimation. It predicts relative depth from a single image, helping applications understand scene structure. This entry links to the Hugging Face implementation of the Small checkpoint, released under Apache 2.0.
TOOL_INTROS.https://huggingface.co/CohereLabs/c4ai-c: Command R7B is Cohere Labs’ 7B multilingual language model for conversation, retrieval-augmented generation and tool use. Its research weights use CC BY-NC 4.0 and require accepting access conditions. Hosted services have separate terms; this is not an unrestricted commercial release.
TOOL_INTROS.https://huggingface.co/01-ai/Yi-1.5-9B-C: Yi-1.5-9B-Chat is 01.AI’s conversational language model focused on English and Chinese, with support for instruction-following, reasoning and coding tasks. Its weights use Apache 2.0. This listing is a specific older checkpoint, not a claim that it is the latest Yi release.
TOOL_INTROS.https://huggingface.co/bigcode/starcoder: StarCoder2-7B is BigCode’s code-generation base model trained on programming-language data. It supports code completion and fill-in-the-middle tasks. It is not instruction-tuned for general chat, and its weights are governed by the BigCode OpenRAIL-M license.
TOOL_INTROS.https://huggingface.co/sarvamai/sarvam-m: Sarvam-M is Sarvam AI’s multilingual, hybrid-reasoning language model built on Mistral Small. It is post-trained for Indian languages and English, with conversation, mathematics and coding capabilities. Its weights use Apache 2.0; this introduction does not claim Urdu support.
TOOL_INTROS.https://huggingface.co/sail/Sailor2-1B-C: Sailor2-1B-Chat is Sea AI Lab’s conversational model for English, Chinese and Southeast Asian languages. It builds on Qwen2.5 and is part of the Sailor2 multilingual research project. This specific small chat checkpoint is released under Apache 2.0.
TOOL_INTROS.https://huggingface.co/upstage/solar-pro: Solar Pro Preview Instruct is Upstage’s 22B instruction-tuned language model for conversation and text tasks. It is an older preview checkpoint with limited language coverage and a 4K context window. Its weights use MIT licensing; this entry does not represent the latest Solar model.
